notes: Every catalog scenario uses only free Basic-tier Kibana features; no Platinum, Enterprise, or subscription-gated surface is required.
Core learner workflows are read-only; controller APIs create and clean up resources.
APM traces and infrastructure support are verified through adapter contracts and must be rechecked if the pinned Stack version changes.
Payment-gated surfaces (APM service map, SLOs, machine learning) and the unverified Maps and Synthetics extensions were removed so the application ships only free open-source features.
